index.dms-arbeiter-ist-keine: DMS_ARBEITER={roh} isn’t a number from 0 to {ARBEITER_MAX} and is ignored.
auftrag.es-laeuft-bereits-bitte: Already running: {titel}. Please wait until it has finished.
dms.ablago-laeuft-im-einrichtungsmodus: Ablago is running in setup mode (no database connected yet). Set it up in the browser first; then the dms command works.
dms.ablago-startet-gerade-migrationen: Ablago is starting (migrations and preparations). The page in the browser shows the progress; try again afterwards.
dms.ablago-konnte-nicht-starten: Ablago could not start. The reason is on the page in the browser and in the container’s log.
dms.ablago-laeuft-nicht-oder: Ablago isn’t running (or is starting). Check the container’s log and try again in a minute.
dms.keine-berechtigung-fuer-rufe: No permission for {datei}. Run dms as the same user as Ablago (e.g. docker exec without --user).
dms.ablago-antwortet-nicht-laeuft: Ablago doesn’t answer. Is it still running? (After a restart, simply try again.)
dms.ohne-terminal-bitte-mit: {frage} – without a terminal please confirm with --ja.
dms.ohne-terminal-das-passwort: Without a terminal give the password with --passwort (or use docker exec -it).
dms.passwort-fuer-gesetzt-alle: Password for {email} set; all sessions of this user have been ended.
dms.achtung-der-benutzer-ist: Caution: the user is deactivated and can’t sign in like this.
dms.die-zwei-faktor-anmeldung: Two-factor sign-in is set up. Without the phone: dms zweifaktor-zuruecksetzen {email}
dms.alle-benutzer-auf-allen: Sign out all users on all devices?
dms.pruefung-von-gestartet-ergebnis: Check of {rest} started. Result: dms sicherung
dms.die-einladung-ist-per: The invitation is on its way by email.
dms.der-dritte-teil-muss: The third part must be valid JSON, e.g. '{"ip":"1.2.3.4"}'.
index.unerwarteter-fehler: Unexpected error – the process exits and restarts
index.datenbank-ohne-volume: The database is only stored inside the container and will be lost with the next update. Add /data/postgres to the Compose file. Rescue the data first (docker compose stop, not down, then docker cp): {link}
index.datenbank-ohne-volume-lasttest: Load test: the database deliberately lives only inside the container – it is gone after the test, as intended.
index.exporte-aus-dem-sicherungsordner: Exports moved from the backup folder to the export folder (unencrypted, not for the backup copy)
index.das-skript-des-lasttests: The load test script (dms-lasttest) is missing in this image.
prozess.netz-gesperrt-steht-weder: Network blocked: {url} is neither in the manifest nor the confirmed service address.
verwaltung.verlauf-zeilen-max: More than {anzahl} lines this hour – further ones are only in the Ablago log.
verwaltung.der-paket-laeufer-wurde: The package runner has been stopped.
verwaltung.der-paket-laeufer-wurde-2: The package runner has been stopped (no more packages with code).
verwaltung.der-paket-laeufer-laeuft: The package runner isn’t running right now.
verwaltung.das-paket-hat-keinen: The package no longer has code.
schrift.zeichen-fehlen_one: PDF created: one character is missing from the embedded font and appears as “�” in the PDF: {zeichen}
schrift.zeichen-fehlen_other: PDF created: {anzahl} characters are missing from the embedded font and appear as “�” in the PDF: {zeichen}
auftrag.unterbrochen: Interrupted: the process in which the job ran was stopped.
prozesse.ungueltig: DMS_PROZESSE={roh} is neither “auto” nor a number from 1 to {max} and is ignored: Ablago runs in one process.
hintergrund.ungueltig: DMS_HINTERGRUND_NICE={roh} isn’t a number from 0 to {max} and is ignored: background work runs with nice {wert}.
hintergrund.start: Background work (workers, package runner, programs such as pdftoppm) at lower priority: nice {wert}
hintergrund.ohne-nice: The priority of background work can’t be lowered here ({fehler}): it carries on at normal priority.
zwischenspeicher.aus: Caches for counts, numbers of results and dates switched off (DMS_ZWISCHENSPEICHER=aus): everything is calculated afresh on every request – for troubleshooting only, slower.
prozesse.leiter-startet: Ablago is restarting the process for background work. Please try again in a moment.
prozesse.leiter-neu: The process for background work has been restarted. Please try again.
prozesse.keine-antwort: Another Ablago process didn’t answer in time.
verwaltung.netz-abgelehnt: Network blocked: {anzahl} × {methode} {host} – the address is not allowed
prozess.ungueltige-methode: Invalid method – only capital letters are allowed, e.g. GET or POST.
